title: Following the Waters
story:
Leaving the quiet banana grove behind, James checked his travel bundle, ensuring his brass map canister and polished compass were nestled safely inside. The cool morning mist lingered over the base of the ancient stone aqueduct as a steady stream of clear water trickled from a moss-covered spillway. Nico scampered up onto the masonry lip, twitching his nose at the refreshing spray before leaping down to lead the way along the damp earth path.

They followed the water where it diverged from the main aqueduct wall into a network of stone-lined irrigation channels. These narrow flumes cut through the shaded hillside, guiding fresh mountain runoff down toward the farming terraces below. James walked alongside the gurgling water, enjoying the soothing sound and the cool air that rose from the rushing stream. Whenever the channel narrowed or dipped beneath low wooden footbridges, Nico balanced nimbly on the stone coping, his long tail flicking for balance as he kept pace with James's steady steps.

As they descended further, the wild jungle scrub gave way to neatly tended agricultural terraces. Rows of young citrus trees and flowering highland crops stretched across the hillside, fed by the continuous flow of the stone channels. James paused at a stone junction where a heavy iron gate controlled the water's direction, watching small silver minnows flash through the clear current. The air here smelled of damp soil, crushed pine needles, and sweet blossoms.

By late afternoon, the irrigation channels led them onto the upper boundary of Finca San Mateo. Below them, stone pathways zigzagged down the stepped slopes toward farm outbuildings nestled in the valley fold. Finding a broad, flat stone ledge beside a bubbling sluice, James set down his pack to rest. Nico curled up in the warm sun against James's knee while James looked out across the peaceful terraced landscape, content with the day's steady journey.
location: Terraced slopes of Finca San Mateo
